title: A Generative Foundation Model for Chest Radiography

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring differences in disease classification performance (F1-scores) between male and female patient cohorts using both real and synthetic chest X-ray test sets.
Measuring differences in disease classification performance (F1-scores) between racial groups (e.g., White, Black) using both real and synthetic chest X-ray test sets.
Measuring differences in disease classification performance (F1-scores) across different age groups (19-40, 41-65, and 66+) using both real and synthetic chest X-ray test sets.
